codeRedTitle: 🔴 Code Red in effect — Monday, August 10
codeRedBody:
During a Code Red, shelter is available to anyone experiencing homelessness, and walk-ins are welcome. Cooling areas are available for anyone experiencing heat-related discomfort. If you are concerned about someone who may need help staying safe in the heat, call 311. Outreach teams are engaging people on the street 24/7.

In the most immediate sense, that also means cooling centers are open. This includes public pools (yes, Red Hook Pool is included), but they would be open whether there was a heat advisory or not. See below for more info on how to stay appropriately cooled and hydrated.

— Mike Racioppo
